snippet.title: Gumdrop Lost in Thyme Debut Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5386820/Gumdrop_Lost_in_Thyme/

In this cozy incremental, harvest wild plants, cook meals, befriend sheep, and buy upgrade potions to explore the magical forest labyrinth and hopefully escape.
